name: Unagui Catalogue Mode for WooCommerce
author: unagui

sections.description:
Turn your online store into a product catalogue with a single click. Unagui Catalogue Mode for WooCommerce allows you to temporarily or permanently disable checkout functionality, making your products visible for browsing but not for purchase.

This is perfect for B2B wholesale sites, maintenance modes, waiting for stock, or simply showcasing products without selling them online.

🚀 Free Features

  • Enable Catalogue Mode Globally: Instantly turn your entire shop into a catalogue.
  • Remove Add to Cart Buttons: Hides the “Add to Cart” button from the Shop, Category, and Single Product pages.
  • Disable Checkout Process: Automatically redirects Cart and Checkout pages to the Shop page to prevent direct URL access.
  • Admin View: Option to keep the store functioning normally for Administrators while showing catalogue mode to everyone else (great for testing).

🔥 Unlock the full potential with Pro

Upgrade now and enjoy powerful features and customization options that are not available in the basic version.
With Unagui Catalogue Mode for WooCommerce Pro, you get access to the following features:

  • Role-Based Rules: Apply catalogue mode only to Guest users or specific user roles.
  • Product/Category Exclusions: specific products or categories to remain purchasable.
  • Custom Buttons: Replace “Add to Cart” with a custom button (e.g., “Contact Us” or “Get a Quote”) linking to a URL.
  • Scheduler: Automatically enable/disable catalogue mode during specific dates or hours.

In addition, with the Pro version you will receive priority support from our dedicated team, ensuring any questions or issues are resolved quickly. Upgrade to Unagui Catalogue Mode for WooCommerce Pro today to improve your store’s flexibility. Visit our Unagui Catalogue Mode for WooCommerce Pro page for more details and to purchase.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Unagui Plugins > Catalogue Mode to enable the mode.
sections.faq:
Does this hide prices?

In the free version, prices remain visible, but the purchasing functionality is removed.

can I apply this only to guest users?

The free version applies catalogue mode globally. The Pro version supports role-based logic.

Does this work with any theme?

Yes, it uses standard WooCommerce hooks to remove buttons and disable purchasing.
